# unifi_network_firewall_zone (Data Source)

Look up a zone-based firewall zone by `zone_key`, `name`, or both (both must match). Built-in zones carry a `zone_key` (`internal`, `external`, `gateway`, `vpn`, `hotspot`, `dmz`); custom zones are found by `name`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Zone name.
- `zone_key` (String) Built-in zone key, e.g. `internal` or `external`.

### Read-Only

- `default_zone` (Boolean) Whether this is a built-in zone.
- `id` (String) Zone `_id`, the `zone_id` a firewall policy references.
- `network_ids` (Set of String) `_id`s of the networks in the zone.
